_comment: Phase 11 (2026-11-12, review item 6): the weak-teacher control's OWN teacher as a feature row.
The weak arm (arm_full.sh TAG=weak) aligns to DINOv3 ViT-L/16 web (eval/extract_dino.py preset
dinov3_vitl16_web, 0.3 B parameters, LVD-1689M); until this row existed its cells were scored against
dinov3-web (ViT-7B/16), a teacher it never saw. Same datasets / fractions / seeds / c_grid as
phase5_web_sweep.json; dinov3-web first (cells cached from phase 1 / 2) so the report prints the two
web teachers side by side. Task index = 6 * model + dataset: dinov3-vitl16-web = tasks 6-11.
Features: experiments/isaac/geobench/dino.sbatch with PRESET=dinov3_vitl16_web DEVICE=cpu (same extractor,
pooling and normalization as the 7B rows, but float32 on a CPU node: the 7B rows are bf16 on an H100; no
GPU slot was free before the supplemental deadline). Each cache records its dtype and device.
Gated by dino_probe.sbatch GATE_ONLY=1 before any cell runs: ENFORCED by requires_gate below
(matrix.sbatch calls eval.gate_marker require; the marker records the size + mtime of the feature files
the gate judged, so a re-extraction needs a new gate). dinov3-web is not listed: its cells already exist
from phase 1 / 2 and its gate ran before markers existed (2026-10).
